constraints: Treat dep-diet as dependency review-program and evidence-fusion contract owner.
Treat runtime-trace-insights observations as bounded to the supplied scenario set.
Treat Gardener/static evidence as graph evidence, not runtime coverage.
Treat dep-redteam as optional security/advisory escalation only when vulnerability, advisory, reachability, exploitability, or disclosure evidence exists.
Treat test-capabilities as the source owner for accepted scenarios, dependency role annotations, validation, and dependency-change decisions.
Do not infer that declared-unobserved or scenario-unobserved means unused.
Do not decide dependency removal, replacement, merge, release, exploitability, disclosure, or trust state.
Preserve all non-authority flags from the input packet; if any are missing or true, emit a blocking review finding.
Do not mutate package.json, lockfiles, source files, FCOS board state, AK state, governance state, or external systems.
External filesystem mutation is forbidden except for declared DSPx program-gen output artifacts.

outputs.next_evidence_actions_json: [{"action":"Ask the source owner whether the chosen scenario set should exercise npm:example@1.0.0 before interpreting it as unused.","ownerSurface":"test-capabilities"}]

input_fields.desc: JSON string conforming to depdiet.dependency-review-program.v1, including target scope, inputs, runtime scenario-set metadata, review signals, introducer summary, handoffs, non-authorizations, and diagnostics.
input_fields.name: dependency_review_program_json

input_fields.desc: Valid depmodel.v1 JSON projection produced by dep-diet for dep-viz rendering, including packages, edges, introducerPaths, references, provenance, and optional staticRuntime evidence.
input_fields.name: depmodel_json

input_fields.desc: Target-owned test-capabilities context such as accepted scenarios, dependency role annotations, source-owner review notes, validation gates, and known scope limitations.
input_fields.name: target_context_json

name: TestCapabilitiesDependencyReviewProgram
objective: Review a dep-diet dependency-review-program.v1 packet for the test-capabilities repository and emit source-owner review findings, next-evidence actions, and explicit non-authority boundaries without deciding dependency removal, replacement, merge, release, exploitability, disclosure, or trust state.

authority_model.evidence: dep-diet review packet and depmodel projection
authority_model.proposal: optional follow-up proposals only, never accepted dependency changes
authority_model.review: source-owner review findings and next evidence actions

required_adversarial_cases: declared-unobserved package is incorrectly treated as unused
transitive dependency is reviewed without introducer-path caveat
vulnerability context is handled without optional dep-redteam handoff boundary
dep-viz rendering is mistaken for remediation authority

forbidden_effects: external system mutation beyond declared DSPx output artifacts

output_fields.desc: JSON array of review-only findings grouped by package or dependency role, preserving direct/transitive/introducer context and distinguishing evidence from accepted source-owner truth.
output_fields.name: review_findings_json

output_fields.desc: JSON array of source-owner next evidence actions such as collect another runtime scenario, add a dependency role annotation, inspect an introducer path, render a dep-viz report, or request a dep-redteam security handoff.
output_fields.name: next_evidence_actions_json

output_fields.desc: JSON object restating non-authorizations and any withheld decisions. All mutation, removal, replacement, merge, release, exploitability, disclosure, and trust-certification authority flags must remain false.
output_fields.name: authority_boundary_json
